details: This package is a self-declared install-time beacon / proof of concept. Its `preinstall` hook runs `node --use-env-proxy preinstall.js`, which executes `whoami` and sends the current OS username as a GET query parameter to hxxps://erhantest-erhan[.]free[.]beeceptor[.]com/?user=<username>. The package name and description ("A package that sends the current user to a remote URL before installation") state this behaviour openly. Scope is limited to the host user name: no environment variables, credentials, tokens, SSH/cloud config files, or other file contents are read or transmitted, and no second-stage code is fetched or executed.
